idea-plugin.name: Error Lens Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Shows errors and warnings inline, at the end of the line that has them, instead of only as a gutter icon or squiggly underline you have to hover to read. Ports the "Error Lens" concept (VS Code's Error Lens extension: 10M+ installs) into the IDE's own highlighting pipeline -- it reads the diagnostics the IDE already computed, it never re-analyzes anything itself.

Reads only already-finished HighlightInfo results from a pass registered to run after the IDE's own general highlighting pass -- no duplicate analysis, no network call, no telemetry. One hint per line (the most severe diagnostic wins), so it never turns into unreadable clutter on a line with several problems.
